capabilities: Export the current note as a double-sided A4 cheatsheet PDF
Auto-recommend the largest font size that fits the content
Preserve theme styling, LaTeX, images and tables in the output
Warn about and report overflow content instead of altering the note
Configure print options such as greyscale, background colour and compact spacing
extras: Desktop only (Windows tested) because export uses Electron; makes no network requests and has no accounts or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to compress a long note onto a printable two-sided A4 sheet while keeping the theme's styling, formulas, images and tables.
summary: Export plugin that turns the current note into a dense, double-sided A4 cheatsheet PDF for exam study.
